According to Federal Reserve economists, without Trump's tariffs, inflation would have dropped to pre-pandemic levels last year.

Tired of winning yet?

The CEO of United Airlines reportedly wants Trump to let his company merge with American Airlines.

That's a terrible idea.

Anti-competitive mega-mergers that stick consumers with higher fares are one of the main reasons flying sucks so much today.

NLRB General Counsel Crystal Carey has moved to end a major labor law case against Amazon, which has also sued to have the entire agency declared unconstitutional. 

Before being appointed by Trump, Carey worked at a corporate law firm that represented Amazon.

Connect the dots.

Reminder that Trump and the GOP snuck a huge tax break into their Big Ugly Bill allowing private jet owners to write off the cost of their planes faster than before.

Meanwhile, the Big Ugly Bill will kick millions of people off food assistance and healthcare programs.

"Party of the working class."

Trump loves touting "no tax on tips," but ignores that his Department of Labor proposed a rule that would make it easier for corporations to misclassify workers.

Millions of gig workers are wrongly labeled "independent contractors," and cut out of benefits and protections designated for employees.

Frank Bisignano is set to testify before the Senate Finance Committee Wednesday. He is simultaneously the “CEO” of IRS and Commissioner of Social Security. 

During his tenure, some troubling patterns have emerged at SSA and IRS, which impact the millions of people who rely on their services. 🧵

OMB Director Russell Vought it set to testify before the House and Senate Budget Committees this week. For far too long, Vought has operated in the shadows as the chief architect of Trump's destruction of the federal government.

It's time to shine a light on Vampire Vought.🧵

Underfunded public services fuel the demand to tax the rich.

"There are so many needs that American families have, and we so often have to hear, ‘Oh, there’s no money for that.’ Well, there’s lots and lots of money," our Director Amy Hanauer explains.
www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026...

A tax season reminder that Intuit TurboTax lobbied the government for years to block free public tax-filing.

Trump then terminated the free IRS Direct File program established under Biden, just a year after the tax prep giant gave his inauguration fund $1M.

Do you see how this works?

Amazon warehouse workers have been trying to unionize for years, largely in response to the corporation's well-documented unsafe working conditions.

But Amazon continues to squash organizing.

Every worker deserves to be safe on the job.
Remember this the next time corporations whine about minimum wage increases.

Since we made this video, Maine and now Virginia have joined the National Popular Vote compact.

Here's what you need to know.

Always follow the money.

Trump is touting the no tax on tips provision in his budget bill.

But many tipped workers won't benefit because their earnings are so low. And the provision expires in 2028.

The estate tax cuts that primarily benefit the rich? Those were made permanent.

Funny how that works.

It’s never been more clear that Donald Trump has completely lost his mind. It’s our responsibility to call on Congress, the military, and any sane individual in this administration to stop him from committing war crimes against the Iranian people.

Billionaires are crying foul about California's proposed wealth tax. Don't fall for their fearmongering. A one-time, 5% tax on their excessive wealth is essential to funding what millions of Californians need — and to preserving our democracy.

Why does the American tax system favor the wealthy? And how did it get this way? I chatted with Jon Stewart about this back in 2012. Sadly it's only gotten worse since then. We must keep up the fight to fix the system.

Huge election wins in Florida (and another on the horizon in Wisconsin). Raising taxes on the rich in Washington. Paid family and medical leave in Virginia. Even in these Trump times, there's good news to be found.
